info.title: bConnect Server Management API
info.description:
The methods offered here provide support for configurations of the baramundi Management Server.
Well known GUIDs: [Administration profile: 41601841-0DA2-4EF1-B810-D72E6231CF1B ]

get.summary: Gets the access rights for an object.

200.description: Returns the access rights for the object with the specified id

404.description: An object with the specified id does not exist or is not visible due to missing read rights

patch.summary: Updates the modifiable values of the specified object permission

requestBody.description: A JSON Patch document consists of a set of operations that allow specific partial changes to an object. The example document contains all modifiable object permission properties.

400.description: The specified values to be modified are invalid

200.description: Returns the new values of the object permission with the specified id

403.description: No permission to modify the values of the object permission with the specified id

404.description: The specified object permission can not be found

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description:
Sorts results by property name and with sort direction. Multiple properties are separated by comma.
Only Name is supported (e. g. Name asc).

parameters.name: SearchQuery
parameters.description: Filters results by matching the given value against searchable properties. Searchable values are Name and Comment.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Filters results by exactly matching name.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The zero-indexed number of the first page that begins the set of pages that are returned in the response.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of items to list on a single page. For example, if page_size is 10, each page shows ten items.
A valid value is a non-negative, non-zero integer. The default value is 20. Maximum value is 1000.
